The Focus Lock and De-Click Switch The focus lock feature enables the precise focus to remain locked in during long exposures, a perfect feature for astrophotographers. The aperture de-click switch creates a smooth and silent operation. Paired with the de-click switch, this lens makes it highly suitable for video. Next page Product Quick Look Rokinon's MF 14mm F2.8 SERIES II Full Frame Ultra Wide Angle Lens for Canon features weather sealing, an aperture de-click switch for smooth and silent operation during video, a rubberized micro pattern focusing grip, and a nine blade circular aperture for greater bokeh. In addition, the focusing control action has been modified with a smoother, perfectly damped long throw for precise follow focus when shooting video. Astrophotographers will also enjoy the 14mm's distinctive focus lock feature to maintain precise focus at infinity during long exposures.
